description: Drives a fountain from one curve. Its value is a pump's level (0-100%) and its colour keyframes (the bar under the graph) the light's colour. All plays the curve on every pump at once; Chase plays it on one pump after another, each starting before the one before it has finished by Overlap % (0% is one pump at a time). On any other model every pixel takes the colour (one pixel at a time for Chase).

properties.label: Type
properties.description: All: every pump plays the curve together. Chase: the curve plays on pump 1, then pump 2, and so on, each starting before the previous one finishes by Overlap % (0% is one pump at a time).

properties.label: Curves
properties.description: The pumps' level (0-100%) and the lights' colour over time. Click Edit Curves to shape the level and set the colour keyframes.

properties.label: Cycles
properties.description: How many times the curve plays over the effect (All), or the whole run through the pumps does (Chase).

properties.label: Direction
properties.description: The order the pumps take their turn in. Bounce goes there and back.

properties.label: Pump Offset
properties.description: Start the run this many pumps along (it wraps round the pumps the effect covers).

properties.label: Overlap %
properties.description: How much of a pump's turn the next pump's turn overlaps. 0% is one pump at a time.
